def candidate_transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0]); bg=g[0][0]; seen=set(); comps=[]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            col=g[r][c]
            if col==bg or (r,c) in seen: continue
            st=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
            while st:
                y,x=st.pop(); cells.append((y,x))
                for yy,xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w and (yy,xx) not in seen and g[yy][xx]==col:
                        seen.add((yy,xx)); st.append((yy,xx))
            comps.append((col,cells))
    marker=None
    for col,cells in comps:
        rs=[r for r,c in cells]; cs=[c for r,c in cells]; r0,r1=min(rs),max(rs); c0,c1=min(cs),max(cs)
        for r,c in ((r0,c0),(r0,c1),(r1,c0),(r1,c1)):
            if len(cells)==(r1-r0+1)+(c1-c0+1)-1 and min(r1-r0+1,c1-c0+1)>=3 and all((r,x) in cells for x in range(c0,c1+1)) and all((y,c) in cells for y in range(r0,r1+1)):
                # arm direction horizontally: outward from corner along row
                horizontal_right = (c==c0)
                marker=(col,cells,c0,c1,r0,r1,horizontal_right)
                break
        if marker: break
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    if marker:
        col,mc,c0,c1,r0,r1,hr=marker
        candidates=[]
        for color,cells in comps:
            if cells is mc: continue
            rs=[r for r,c in cells]; cs=[c for r,c in cells]
            # Look away from the marker's horizontal arm; choose closest by gap.
            if hr and max(cs)<c0: dist=c0-max(cs)-1
            elif not hr and min(cs)>c1: dist=min(cs)-c1-1
            else: continue
            candidates.append((dist,-len(cells),color,cells))
        if candidates:
            _,_,_,target=min(candidates,key=lambda x:(x[0],x[1]))
            for r,c in target: out[r][c]=col
    return out
out=candidate_transform(grid)
